extract_closed_option.effect: Disables mono-phase extraction/caching of closed subterms into additional _closed declarations. It does not disable general codegen, base/mono/impure saves, kernel checking, ilean collection or final C output.
extract_closed_option.tradeoff: Might reduce auxiliary declarations and closure-cache storage, but may duplicate constructor work or enlarge emitted bodies/runtime work. No memory/time measurement; not recommended as an additional uncontrolled change alongside the fixed ten-definition proposal.
